# Find Embeddings
Collects the ids of all embedded documents in the search categories, for use as RAG sources.
## When to use
- Before answering a question from the knowledge base, e.g. support emails.
## How it works
1. Finds every embedded record in semantic-enabled modules that belongs to any search category. 2. Puts the ids (`<module>_<id>`) into `embeddings`. 3. Then works like ToolsCallingSkill: lets the LLM pick a child step and fill its parameters.
## Inputs
None. It does not read any values from the agent context.
## Outputs
- `embeddings`: JSON array of embedded document ids
## Implementation
- Bean `embeddingFinderSkill`: `org.entermediadb.ai.skills.EmbeddingFinderSkill` - Agent type: `taskagent`
